g000.content: The user needs to draw multiple asteroid collision polygons in the Godot viewport.
g000.title: Asteroid polygon drawing

g001.content: The asteroid script extends CharacterBody2D, references Sprite2D, CollisionPolygon2D and CollisionVariants, preloads four asteroid textures, and sets the matching texture and collision polygon by variant index.
g001.title: Asteroid variant script

g002.content: The server should authoritatively handle asteroid collision because variants have different collision shapes.
g002.title: Server-authoritative asteroid collision

g003.content: The bullet and asteroid scenes are built.
g003.title: Bullet and asteroid scenes

g004.content: Work is scoped to asteroid spawning and despawning for now.
g004.title: Current asteroid scope

g005.content: Asteroids should spawn off-screen, travel in a randomish direction toward the player, have a random size from 1 to 4, and use a random texture with matching collision handled by the asteroid script.
g005.title: Asteroid spawning requirements
